Third-party components shipped with the zoal-atc plugin
=======================================================

whisper.cpp v1.9.1 (MIT)
  https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp
  Linked into the plugin; transcribes push-to-talk.
  models/ggml-small.en-q5_1.bin is OpenAI Whisper small.en (MIT), quantised by
  the whisper.cpp project.

sherpa-onnx v1.13.8 (Apache-2.0)
  https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx
  Synthesises the controllers' voices. Linked statically on macOS; shipped as
  sherpa-onnx-c-api.dll / libsherpa-onnx-c-api.so beside the plugin elsewhere.
  It includes:
    ONNX Runtime (MIT)            https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
    espeak-ng (GPL-3.0-or-later)  https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng
    piper-phonemize (MIT)         https://github.com/rhasspy/piper-phonemize

Kokoro-82M v0.19 (Apache-2.0)
  https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M
  models/kokoro-en-v0_19, as packaged by sherpa-onnx; its LICENSE is in that
  directory.
